blurb: Pseudonymous macro finance commentator on X.com whose self-described bread-and-butter is fixed income (bonds), with equities and FX as secondary coverage. Posts analytical threads on monetary policy, Fed communications, and labor market dynamics — including detailed breakdowns of speeches like Powell's Jackson Hole address. The account name is a wry nod to the Efficient Market Hypothesis. No verified real-world identity or institutional affiliation is publicly disclosed.
